test_trace_parsing_default_config: test that parsing a PyTorch trace with the default ParserConfig includes all expected columns in the resulting DataFrame
test_trace_parsing_custom_config: test that parsing a PyTorch trace with a custom ParserConfig includes only the specified subset of columns
create_trace_from_json: create a Trace object from a JSON trace file by writing trace data and calling parse_traces
write_trace_to_file: write a dictionary of trace events to a compressed JSON trace file using write_trace
configure_parser_with_custom_args: configure a ParserConfig with a custom list of AVAILABLE_ARGS keys and set it as the default
